one_use.no_hidden_retries: one provider-create call and one resource for this invocation. A replacement pod, an internal redraw, a fresh run_id or a re-issuance does not evade the package's count of three.
one_use.after_consumption: this grant is spent. A further attempt needs a NEW grant, a NEW launch-bound readiness record, a NEW one-use authorization and a NEW bundle, and is permitted only while the package's six retry conditions all hold.

package.limits_do_not_transfer: the engineering allowance, the per-attempt ceiling, the attempt count, the package total and the project cap bind separately. A cheap failure does not buy a fourth attempt; an unspent engineering allowance does not raise this ceiling.
